description: Triple Brake System: Color-coded front and rear brakes plus a coaster brake teach safe stopping and control. Perfect Fit™ Frame: Low center of gravity and upright geometry create a natural riding position that keeps balance easy and feet flat for confident learning. 3 Ways to Ride: Start with Quick Connect training wheels for stability, remove pedals for balance bike mode, or ride standard two-wheel style as skills grow. Comfortable Fit: Easy-adjust memory foam padded seat and smaller crank make pedaling simple and smooth for young riders. Parent-Friendly Safety: Full chainguard, wide tires, and rear assist handle support easy guidance and peace of mind.
